rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0001
rows.name:
So, it's finally time. We've
prepared as best we can.

rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0002
rows.name:
We actually put together a
secret weapon, just in case
this place gets attacked again.

rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Its name is... the "Magnificent
Monster Extermination Machine"!!

rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0004
rows.name:
As you can see, Dodon worked
hard to modify the great
gold-collecting machine!

rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0005
rows.name:
I don't know how he did it, but he
even managed to get the thing to
fly! Monsters won't stand a chance!

rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Anyway, that's how it is. Leave
the capital to us.

rows.label: tlk70000066_05_msg0007
rows.name:
We're not going to let things end
here. We won't let the bad guys have
their way!
